Solve this 8-puzzle with the minimum number of moves.
The blank is '_'. Each move slides the blank one cell: U (up), D (down), L (left) or R (right); the tile there takes the blank's place.
The blank cannot leave the 3x3 board. Every move costs 1.

8 1 6
Goal:
